adjudication.rationale: In spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb, the example named "is 404 without an embed_url" only asserts `response.should_not be_success` after `get :best` with no params. In EmbedController#best, `params.require(:embed_url)` will raise `ActionController::ParameterMissing`, so the request will fail, but the spec does not assert a 404 (or any specific status) and would pass for other failure statuses (e.g., 400/500). This is a concrete, diff-grounded test weakness/mismatch between the spec title and what it verifies, not a runtime defect introduced by the controller itself.
